ACID='PA1566079' (UPDATED) .
ACID='PA1536913' (DELETED) . 
ACID='PA1538227' (UNCHANGED) .
ACID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select ACID ACID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_GENACCTCLASS WHERE ACID='PA1566079'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_GENACCTCLASS WHERE ACID='PA1536913'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_GENACCTCLASS WHERE ACID='PA1538227'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_GENACCTCLASS WHERE ACID='9999' ) temp order by ACID, SCD_START_DATE
